page.overview:
Who is G. Harry Stein?

Captain G. Harry Stein was a Starfleet officer of the 24th century.

In 2364, he was the commander of the . Sometime in that year, he received an order about the Rigel/Andor subspace relays from Commodore Peter Bryce of the Starfleet Advanced Technologies Division. (, okudagram)
